modern: Look at everything that exists, and observe that it is already dissolving and changing, and as it were decaying or dispersing, or that everything is so made by nature as to die.
original: Look at everything that exists, and observe that it is already in dissolution and in change, and as it were putrefaction or dispersion, or that everything is so constituted by nature as to die.
